reviews.name: Neil C.
reviews.text:
Victor and his team did an amazing job, they were on time, worked fast, and went above and beyond. (Even cleaning out a vent while they were working in the same area which was not their responsibility at all!).

I highly recommend VME - They upgraded our service and they were a pleasure to work with.

reviews.name: david d.
reviews.text:
Victor was great to work with and he was able to schedule the work that needed to be done in a timely manner.
His crew was outstanding and really did a great job that was clean and efficient!
Would recommend to any one looking for a professional electrical company.

reviews.name: Brian E.
reviews.text: Great response time and nothing but professionalism from Victor and his team, every single time. I am happy to recommend him to all of my family and friends, as his team's work is excellent and the billing is fair and transparent.

reviews.name: MICHAEL E.
reviews.text:
Amazingly professional and efficient service
I have used VME electric many times in the past several years and Victor and his team always perform their work admirably
I would not use any other electricians on my home!

reviews.name: Diane F.
reviews.text: Very responsive and helpful. Would recommend.
